entries.title: Ezekiel 26:1
segments: ¶And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, [that] the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:2
segments: Son of man, because Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken, the gate of the peoples! she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished [now] she is laid waste;

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:3
segments: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:4
segments: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. And I will scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:5
segments: She shall be [a place] for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil for the nations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:6
segments: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:7
segments: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring from the north, against Tyre, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, the king of kings, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and an assemblage, and much people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:8
segments: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field, and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and lift up the target against thee;

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:9
segments: and he shall set his engines of attack against thy walls, and with his spikes he shall break down thy towers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:10
segments: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee; thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter through thy gates, as a city is entered into, wherein is made a breach.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:11
segments: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people by the sword, and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:12
segments: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy wares; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:13
segments: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:14
segments: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be [a place] for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:15
segments: ¶Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:16
segments: And all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling, they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble [every] moment, and be astonied because of thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:17
segments: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How hast thou perished, that wast inhabited from the seas, O renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, --she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all them that dwell therein!

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:18
segments: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; and the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:19
segments: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters cover thee:

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:20
segments: then will I bring thee down, with them that go down to the pit, to the people of old time, and will cause thee to dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

entries.title: Ezekiel 26:21
segments: And I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no [more]; and thou shalt be sought for, and shalt never be found again, for ever, saith the Lord Jehovah.
